title: The Fire for the Late Canoes

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Two canoes are still out after sunset, and a villager decides to keep a fire burning on the beach.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two canoes are still out after sunset, and (name1) decides to keep a fire burning on the beach.

choices.label: Add Green Leaves for More Smoke.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The canoes find their way home by the light.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The canoes had stayed on another beach and return in the morning, grateful for the thought.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The fire stays bright, and everyone gets some sleep.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The turns are confusing, and the fire nearly goes out once.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The smoke helps the canoes find the beach at dawn.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The smoke drifts into the village, and some villagers cough and complain.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The lanterns make a glowing path for the canoes.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The wind blows out half of them, and the villager relights them patiently.
